overview: The Sunrise AP Startup Support Fund is a state-level initiative by the Government of Andhra Pradesh aimed at fostering innovation and supporting early-stage startups through financial assistance and ecosystem development. The scheme provides seed funding and mentorship to eligible startups operating within the state, with a focus on technology-driven and high-growth ventures. It is managed under the Sunrise Andhra Pradesh portal, which serves as the central hub for startup-related policies and programs in the state.
objectives: To provide financial support to early-stage startups in Andhra Pradesh
To promote innovation and entrepreneurship within the state
To strengthen the startup ecosystem through mentorship and guidance
To encourage technology-driven and scalable business models
To create employment opportunities through startup growth
eligibility: Startups must be registered in Andhra Pradesh, have a valid DPIIT recognition certificate, be incorporated not more than 5 years ago, and operate in sectors such as technology, manufacturing, or services with high growth potential. The startup must not have received more than INR 50 lakh in funding from other government sources prior to applying.
benefits: Financial support in the form of seed funding, access to mentorship and incubation support, networking opportunities with investors and industry experts, facilitation of regulatory approvals, and visibility through state-level startup events and platforms.
financial_support: The scheme provides a one-time grant of up to INR 25 lakh per eligible startup as seed funding. The funds are disbursed in tranches based on milestone achievement and are intended for product development, market validation, and initial operational expenses. There is no equity dilution or repayment obligation under this grant.
application_process: 1. Visit the official Sunrise AP portal at https://sunrise.ap.gov.in 2. Register on the portal using valid email and mobile number 3. Log in and navigate to the 'Startup Support Fund' section 4. Fill out the online application form with startup details 5. Upload required documents including incorporation certificate, DPIIT recognition, and business plan 6. Submit the application for review 7. Await evaluation by the screening committee 8. If shortlisted, attend a pitch interview or presentation 9. Receive approval and disbursement of funds upon meeting milestones
required_documents: Bank account details of the startup
Declaration of no prior government funding exceeding INR 50 lakh
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year subject to fund availability
implementing_agency: Information Technology, Electronics & Communications Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
caveats: Funding is subject to availability of budget under the scheme
Startups must utilize funds only for approved purposes as per the sanction letter
Misuse of funds may lead to recovery and blacklisting
The grant is one-time and non-renewable
Startups receiving funding from other state or central schemes may be ineligible if total support exceeds prescribed limits
